title: Effect of rare-earth ytterbium doping on the microwave absorption performance of nickel–cobalt ferrite
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38345-38352
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06136E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Guangming Wang, Zhijun Ma, Yunsheng Zheng, Liang Cheng, Huiling Xing, Zhuomin Li
When Yb3+ = 0.02, Ni0.5Co0.5Yb0.02Fe1.98O4 has the best microwave absorption performance, the best reflection loss is −21.04 dB, and the effective microwave absorption bandwidth in the Ku band is 2.55 GHz (15.45–18.00 GHz).
